Milia are harmless and often resolve on their own without treatment.
Common causes of milia include trapped dead skin cells, sun damage, and the use of heavy skincare products.
Professional treatments for milia include cryotherapy, laser ablation, and manual extraction.
Preventative measures for milia include gentle exfoliation and using non-comedogenic products.
